name: Disturbed

features.name: Enhancer Cells
features.description: Up to four cells add modifiers each spin.

features.name: Pre-Op Spins
features.description: Free spins that the Executioner scatter can upgrade.

review:
Disturbed is an asylum-themed slot on a 4-2-4-2-4 grid, where up to four Enhancer Cells can light up each spin to add xWays, splits and other modifiers. Mrs. Nudge, an xNudge Wild that only lands on reel 3, gains +1 per nudge.

Three or more scatters start Pre-Op Spins, and an Executioner scatter on reel 3 can upgrade the bonus. Nolimit rates it Insane volatility, with a 54,391x ceiling and a fairly high 33% hit rate. The theme is deliberately unsettling.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
